text.answer: Janna is a support mage who protects allies with shields, healing, knockups and knockbacks. Her damaging spells deal magic damage and scale with AP.
text.counterplay: Dodge her whirlwind, account for her knockback when approaching, and pressure allies after her shield fades.

text.answer: Janna places a charging whirlwind whose direction is fixed when cast; she can release it early, or it releases automatically. The released whirlwind deals magic damage and knocks up enemies hit; charging increases its range, speed, damage and knockup duration.
text.counterplay: Move out of the whirlwind's path and avoid approaching along its cast direction.
